organic-red-quinoa.longDescription: Organic quinoa is a nutrient-dense, gluten-free whole grain known for its high-quality plant protein, fiber, and essential minerals. Sourced from certified organic farms, it is naturally processed without any chemicals or additives, making it a healthy and versatile choice for everyday meals.

features.title: Gluten-free & easy to digest
features.line: A great alternative to refined grains.

features.title: Versatile & easy to cook
features.line: Use in salads, bowls, pulao, or as a rice substitute.

howToUse: Rinse 1 cup of quinoa under cold running water.
Simmer with 2 cups of water for about 15 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and serve warm in bowls, salads or pulao.
